examples: Zijn idealistische visie inspireert veel mensen.
Het plan is te idealistisch voor de realiteit.

chinese: 他理想主义的观点激励了许多人。
这个计划对现实来说太理想主义了。
english: His idealistic vision inspires many people.
The plan is too idealistic for reality.

words.notes: 形容词，源自 ideaal（理想）+ -istisch（主义的）

examples: Ik moet mijn identiteitskaart tonen.
Vergeet je identiteitskaart niet.

english: I need to show my ID card.
Don't forget your identity card.

words.notes: 复合名词，由 identiteit（身份）和 kaart（卡片）组成

examples: Ik kijk op hem aan om een oplossing te vinden.
Je kunt niet op iedereen aankijken.

chinese: 我指望他找到解决办法。
你不能对每个人都抱有期待。
english: I expect him to find a solution.
You cannot expect anything from everyone.

words.notes: 固定短语，表示对某人有期望

translation.english: to draw someone's attention to something

examples: Ik attendeer u op het feit dat...
Hij attendeerde me op het probleem.

english: I would like to draw your attention to the fact that...
He drew my attention to the problem.

words.notes: 正式短语，attenderen 是可分动词，attenderen op 意为提醒注意

translation.english: to help someone, to attend to someone

examples: De receptionist stond ons te woord.
Ik sta u graag te woord.

english: The receptionist attended to us.
I am happy to help you.

words.notes: 固定短语，字面意思是站出来对某人说话，引申为帮助、接待

translation.english: to attach great importance to something

examples: Wij nemen kwaliteit hoog op.
De organisatie neemt veiligheid hoog op.

english: We attach great importance to quality.
The organization attaches great importance to safety.

words.notes: 固定短语，opnemen 字面意思是采纳/接纳

translation.english: to take something for granted, to accept something

examples: Je moet soms ongemakken voor lief nemen.
Ik neem het risico voor lief.

chinese: 有时候你必须接受一些不便。
english: Sometimes you have to accept inconveniences.
I accept the risk.

words.notes: 固定短语，voor lief nemen 字面意思是为爱接受

examples: Ik heb dorst. Mag ik water drinken?
Heeft u dorst?

english: I am thirsty. May I drink some water?
Are you thirsty?

words.notes: 常用短语，荷兰语中用 hebben dorst 而不是 zijn dorst

examples: Ik heb honger. Wanneer eten we?
Heb je honger?

chinese: 我饿了。我们什么时候吃饭？
english: I am hungry. When do we eat?
Are you hungry?

words.notes: 常用短语，荷兰语中用 hebben honger 而不是 zijn honger

examples: De importheffing is verhoogd.
Wij moeten importheffing betalen.

chinese: 我们需要缴纳进口关税。
english: The import duty has been raised.
We need to pay import duty.

words.notes: 贸易词汇，由 import（进口）和 heffing（征收）组成

translation.english: to be eligible for, to qualify for

examples: Hij komt in aanmerking voor de functie.
Wie komt in aanmerking voor de subsidie?

chinese: 他有资格担任这个职位。
谁有资格获得这项补贴？
english: He is eligible for the position.
Who qualifies for the subsidy?

words.notes: 固定短语，aanmerking 字面意思是考虑

translation.english: to take into account, to observe

examples: Wij moeten de regels in acht nemen.
Neem mijn advies in acht.

english: We must take the rules into account.
Take my advice into account.

words.notes: 固定短语，achten 字面意思是尊重/重视

translation.english: in all respects, in every way

examples: Het project is in alle opzichten geslaagd.
Hij is in alle opzichten een goed mens.

chinese: 这个项目在各方面都成功了。
他在各方面都是个好人。
english: The project has succeeded in all respects.
He is a good person in every way.

words.notes: 固定短语，opzicht 意为方面

examples: Het park is in beheer van de gemeente.
Het bedrijf is in beheer van de overheid.

chinese: 这个公园由市政府管理。
english: The park is under the management of the municipality.
The company is under the management of the government.

words.notes: 固定短语，beheer 意为管理

examples: Zij ging in de geneeskunde in beroep.
Ik wil in het onderwijs in beroep gaan.

english: She pursued a career in medicine.
I want to pursue a career in education.

words.notes: 固定短语，beroep 意为职业

examples: De politie nam het wapen in beslag.
Het gereedschap werd in beslag genomen.

english: The police seized the weapon.
The tools were confiscated.

words.notes: 固定短语，beslag 字面意思是占据/扣押

translation.english: to come to someone's aid, to stand up for

examples: Hij sprong in de bres voor de zwakken.
Wij moeten in de bres springen voor het milieu.

chinese: 我们必须为环境挺身而出。
english: He stood up for the weak.
We must stand up for the environment.

words.notes: 固定短语，bres 意为缺口，字面意思是跳进缺口

translation.english: to be in a tight spot, to be under pressure

examples: Het bedrijf zit in de knel.
Hij zit financieel in de knel.

english: The company is in a tight spot.
He is under financial pressure.

words.notes: 固定短语，knel 意为挤压/困境

translation.english: to stand in line, to queue

examples: We moeten in de rij staan.
Wie staat er in de rij?

english: We need to stand in line.
Who is standing in line?

words.notes: 常用短语，rij 意为行列

examples: Hij liet zijn vrienden in de steek.
Laat me niet in de steek.

english: He abandoned his friends.
Don't let me down.

words.notes: 固定短语，steek 字面意思是刺伤，引申为背叛

examples: In dit opzicht heb je gelijk.
Het product is in dit opzicht uniek.

chinese: 这个产品在这方面是独一无二的。
english: In this respect you are right.
The product is unique in this respect.

words.notes: 常用短语，opzicht 意为方面

examples: In eerste instantie dacht ik dat het onmogelijk was.
In eerste instantie moet u contact opnemen met uw huisarts.

chinese: 起初我认为这是不可能的。
首先你需要联系你的家庭医生。
english: At first I thought it was impossible.
Initially you should contact your GP.

words.notes: 正式短语，instance 意为实例/阶段

examples: De koning wil zijn reputatie in ere herstellen.
Wij moeten de traditie in ere herstellen.

english: The king wants to restore his reputation.
We must restore the tradition.

words.notes: 固定短语，ere 意为荣誉

translation.english: to be at fault, to be in default

examples: De huurder is in gebreke.
De overheid is in gebreke gebleven.

english: The tenant is at fault.
The government has failed in its duty.

words.notes: 法律短语，gebreke 意为过失/缺陷

translation.english: to enter into discussion, to start negotiating

examples: Wij moeten in gesprek gaan met de klant.
De partijen gaan in gesprek over het contract.

chinese: 我们需要与客户开始谈话。
各方将就合同进行谈判。
english: We need to enter into discussion with the client.
The parties will negotiate about the contract.

words.notes: 常用短语，gesprek 意为谈话/会谈

examples: Het probleem is in grote mate opgelost.
Hij is in grote mate verantwoordelijk.

chinese: 问题在很大程度上已经解决。
他在很大程度上负有责任。
english: The problem is solved to a large extent.
He is responsible to a large extent.

words.notes: 常用短语，mate 意为程度

translation.english: heart and soul, through and through

examples: Hij is een kunstenaar in hart en nieren.
Zij is in hart en nieren eerlijk.

chinese: 他是一位全心全意的艺术家。
english: He is an artist heart and soul.
She is honest through and through.

words.notes: 习语，字面意思是心和肾，引申为完全、彻底

examples: Ik dank u in het bijzonder voor uw hulp.
De jongeren in het bijzonder hebben belangstelling.

english: I thank you in particular for your help.
Especially the young people are interested.

words.notes: 常用短语，bijzonder 意为特别的

translation.english: to be at issue, to be in dispute

examples: Het eigendom is in het geding.
Of het waar is, is in het geding.

english: Ownership is in dispute.
Whether it is true is at issue.

words.notes: 法律短语，geding 意为诉讼/争议

examples: In het kader van het project...
In het kader van de wet...

english: Within the framework of the project...
Within the framework of the law...

words.notes: 正式短语，kader 意为框架/边框

translation.english: to keep an eye on, to watch

examples: Houd het kind in het oog.
Wij houden de situatie in het oog.

english: Keep an eye on the child.
We are watching the situation.

words.notes: 常用短语，oog 意为眼睛

translation.english: in any case, in any event

examples: In ieder geval zullen we zien.
In ieder geval bedankt voor uw hulp.

chinese: 无论如何我们都会看到。
无论如何谢谢你的帮助。
english: In any case we will see.
In any case thank you for your help.

words.notes: 常用短语，geval 意为情况/案例

translation.chinese: 在困境中，处于不利境地
translation.english: in a bad spot, in a difficult position

examples: Het bedrijf zit in lichterlaaie.
Hij komt in lichterlaaie door de schandalen.

chinese: 他因丑闻陷入不利境地。
english: The company is in a bad spot.
He is in a difficult position because of the scandals.

words.notes: 习语，lichterlaaie 原指火灾的轻烟，引申为困境

translation.english: to take into consideration, to consider

examples: Neem alle aspecten in ogenschouw.
Wij moeten de gevolgen in ogenschouw nemen.

english: Take all aspects into consideration.
We must consider the consequences.

words.notes: 正式短语，ogenschouw 意为审视/观察

translation.english: to be on the rise, to be emerging

examples: De techniek is in opkomst.
Er is een nieuwe stijl in opkomst.

chinese: 有一种新风格正在兴起。
english: The technology is on the rise.
A new style is emerging.

words.notes: 常用短语，opkomst 意为兴起/增长

examples: Ik maak de kamer in orde.
Maak uw zaken in orde.

english: I arrange the room.
Get your affairs in order.

words.notes: 常用短语，orde 意为秩序

examples: Ik koffie in plaats van thee.
In plaats van klagen, moet je actie ondernemen.

chinese: 与其抱怨，不如采取行动。
english: I drink coffee instead of tea.
Rather than complaining, you should take action.

words.notes: 常用短语，plaats 意为位置

examples: Ik geef dit in ruil voor dat.
Wij werken in ruil voor betaling.

english: I give this in exchange for that.
We work in exchange for payment.

words.notes: 常用短语，ruil 意为交换

examples: Het project gaat in sneltreinvaart.
De technologie ontwikkelt zich in sneltreinvaart.

english: The project proceeds at full speed.
Technology develops rapidly.

words.notes: 习语，sneltrein 意为高速列车

translation.english: to be able to, to be capable of

examples: Ik ben in staat om dit te doen.
Is hij in staat om de verantwoordelijkheid te dragen?

chinese: 他能够承担这个责任吗？
english: I am able to do this.
Is he capable of bearing the responsibility?

words.notes: 常用短语，staat 意为状态

translation.english: in contrast to, in contrast with

examples: In tegenstelling tot gisteren is het vandaag warm.
In tegenstelling tot wat ik dacht...

chinese: 与昨天相反，今天很暖和。
english: In contrast to yesterday, today is warm.
In contrast to what I thought...

words.notes: 常用短语，tegenstelling 意为对比/相反

translation.english: in relation to, in comparison with

examples: In verhouding tot vorig jaar is de omzet gestegen.
De prijs in verhouding tot de kwaliteit is redelijk.

chinese: 与去年相比，营业额增长了。
价格与质量相比是合理的。
english: In relation to last year, the turnover has increased.
The price in comparison with the quality is reasonable.

words.notes: 常用短语，verhouding 意为比例/关系

translation.english: to be absent, to be in default

examples: Hij is in verzuim.
Het bedrijf is in verzuim met de betaling.

english: He is absent.
The company is in default of payment.

words.notes: 短语，verzuim 意为过失/缺席

translation.english: in full swing, in full progress

examples: De bouw is in volle gang.
De discussie is in volle gang.

english: The construction is in full swing.
The discussion is in full progress.

words.notes: 常用短语，gang 意为进程

translation.chinese: 风雨无阻，在任何情况下
translation.english: in all weathers, through thick and thin

examples: Hij werkt in weer en wind.
Wij moeten in weer en wind klaarstaan.

chinese: 我们必须在任何情况下都准备好。
english: He works in all weathers.
We must be ready through thick and thin.

words.notes: 习语，weer 意为天气，wind 意为风

examples: Met inachtneming van de regels...
De inachtneming van veiligheid is verplicht.

english: With consideration of the rules...
Observance of safety is mandatory.

words.notes: 抽象名词，源自 aannemen（采纳）和 acht（考虑），通常不可数

examples: Neem contact op, indien nodig.
Wij komen morgen terug, indien nodig.

chinese: 如果需要，我们明天回来。
english: Contact us if necessary.
We will return tomorrow if necessary.

words.notes: 常用短语，indien 是正式的 wenn（如果）

translation.english: to take into account, to consider

examples: Wij nemen uw klacht in dien.
Het bedrijf neemt suggesties in dien.

english: We take your complaint into account.
The company takes suggestions into account.

words.notes: 可分动词，dien 意为服务/用途

examples: De maatschappij is erg individualistisch.
Individualistische cultuur beïnvloedt het sociale leven.

chinese: 个人主义文化影响社会生活。
english: Society is very individualistic.
Individualistic culture influences social life.

words.notes: 形容词，源自 individueel（个人的）

examples: Het is een indrukwekkend gebouw.
Zij gaf een indrukwekkende presentatie.

chinese: 这是一座令人印象深刻的建筑。
她做了一场令人印象深刻的演示。
english: It is an impressive building.
She gave an impressive presentation.

words.notes: 形容词，源自 indruk（印象）和 wekken（激起）

translation.english: to inquire about, to ask about

examples: Ik informeer naar de mogelijkheden.
Hij informeerde naar de openingstijden.

english: I inquire about the possibilities.
He asked about the opening hours.

words.notes: 短语，informeren 字面意思是通知/告知

examples: De infrastructuur wordt gemoderniseerd.
Investeringen in infrastructuur zijn nodig.

english: Infrastructure is being modernized.
Investments in infrastructure are needed.

words.notes: 技术词汇，指道路、桥梁、电力等基础设施

translation.english: to address something, to go into something

examples: De minister ging in op de klachten.
Wij moeten ingaan op de details.

english: The minister addressed the complaints.
We need to go into the details.

words.notes: 固定短语，ingaan 意为进入/着手

examples: Het personeel ging tegen het plan in.
Wij gaan tegen deze maatregel in.

english: The staff opposed the plan.
We object to this measure.

words.notes: 固定短语，tegen 意为反对

examples: Het parlement heeft initiatiefrecht.
De commissie heeft geen initiatiefrecht.

english: Parliament has the right of initiative.
The committee does not have the right of initiative.

words.notes: 法律/政治词汇，由 initiatief（倡议）和 recht（权利）组成

examples: Zij is initiatiefrijk en betrouwbaar.
Het bedrijf zoekt initiatiefrijke werknemers.

chinese: 公司正在寻找积极主动的员工。
english: She is proactive and reliable.
The company seeks proactive employees.

words.notes: 形容词，rijk 意为丰富的，指充满倡议精神

examples: Hij heeft veel inlevingsvermogen.
Inlevingsvermogen is belangrijk voor een docent.

english: He has a lot of empathy.
Empathy is important for a teacher.

words.notes: 抽象名词，由 inleven（融入）和 vermogen（能力）组成，通常不可数

translation.english: to be responsible for, to guarantee

examples: Ik sta in voor de kwaliteit.
Wie staat er voor dit project in?

english: I guarantee the quality.
Who is responsible for this project?

words.notes: 固定短语，instaan 字面意思是站出来支持

examples: De raad heeft instemmingsrecht.
Medewerkers hebben instemmingsrecht bij belangrijke beslissingen.

chinese: 员工在重要决策中有同意权。
english: The council has the right of consent.
Employees have the right of consent in important decisions.

words.notes: 法律/工作词汇，由 instemming（同意）和 recht（权利）组成

examples: Dit onderwerp interesseert me niet.
Wat interesseert u?

english: This subject does not interest me.
What interests you?

words.notes: 动词，常以 mij（我）为宾语，表示使...感兴趣

examples: Let op de interpunctie.
De interpunctie moet correct zijn.

english: Pay attention to punctuation.
Punctuation must be correct.

words.notes: 语言学术语，通常不可数，由 inter-（在...之间）和 punctie（点）组成

examples: De investeerders zijn tevreden.
Wij zoeken investeerders voor dit project.

chinese: 我们为这个项目寻找投资者。
english: The investors are satisfied.
We are looking for investors for this project.

words.notes: 职业词汇，源自 investeren（投资）

translation.english: to have influence, to exert influence

examples: Hij heeft veel invloed op de beslissing.
Het weer heeft invloed op de oogst.

english: He has much influence on the decision.
The weather influences the harvest.

words.notes: 常用短语，invloed 意为影响（注意拼写是 v 而非 w）

translation.english: entry into force, coming into effect

examples: De wet treedt volgende week in werking.
De inwerkingtreding van het contract wordt verwacht.

english: The law enters into force next week.
The entry into force of the contract is expected.

words.notes: 法律词汇，通常不可数，由 in werking treden（生效）组成

translation.chinese: 富有洞察力的，有启发性的

examples: Zij gaf een inzichtgevende presentatie.
Dit is een inzichtgevend boek.

chinese: 她做了一场富有洞察力的演示。
这是一本有启发性的书。
english: She gave an insightful presentation.
This is an insightful book.

words.notes: 形容词，由 inzicht（洞察）和 gevend（给予）组成

translation.english: it can be said that, one can speak of

examples: Er is te spreken over een verbetering.
Over kwaliteit is te spreken.

english: One can speak of an improvement.
One can speak of quality.

words.notes: 常用短语，用于表达某种情况或评价
